# Support

## Add-on support

For installation, startup, Ingress, direct-access authentication, or Home
Assistant packaging problems, first review the [add-on documentation][docs] and
existing [issues][issues]. If the problem remains, open a bug report and include
the requested environment details and logs.

Remove passwords, Plex tokens, hostnames, IP addresses, and personal viewing
information before sharing logs publicly.

## Tautulli support

If the same problem occurs in a standard Tautulli installation, use the
[upstream Tautulli support channels][upstream] instead. This repository only
maintains the Home Assistant packaging and integration layer.

## Security

Do not open a public support request for a suspected vulnerability. Follow the
[security policy][security] to report it privately.
